text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, King. The real reason you volunteered to be Cheer Squad Captain was so you could cheer on Kawakami, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?! W-whatever gave you that idea? A-a-as if a first-class cheer captain like myself would ever show blatant favoritism towards a single Uma Musume--!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa~ so obvious. It's only a matter of time before everyone catches on. ...Along with how seriously you're pouring your heart into being Captain.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's why what I'm about to tell you, who's working so earnestly, stays strictly between the two of us, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eh? Whatever do you mean by--

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...It's kind of embarrassing for me to admit, though! Anyway, the whole reason I even signed up for the Cheer Squad this year--

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Old Man
text_block_list.text: Oh! Na-chan, and... the Captain you mentioned before? Looks like you two are working real hard! I'm rooting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Old Lady
text_block_list.text: It does feel a bit odd cheering on the cheerleaders, but... Fufufu. Say, how about some fresh juice? Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks, mister and ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it! We're all basically members of Na-chan's personal Cheer Squad around here! Fight on, right?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Cheer Squad?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... They don't have fancy uniforms or big taiko drums, of course.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, the reason I wanted to give being on the Cheer Squad a shot was entirely because of this squad right here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I knew full well I was aiming way out of my league. But I just couldn't bring myself to give up, even if I looked totally out of place on that glorious grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And once I finally stood there and took it all in, I realized just how massive that stage really was. Before I knew it, it was too late to regret it... and my legs turned to jelly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My hands were trembling non-stop. But right at that very moment--

text_block_list.name: Shopping District People
text_block_list.text: Na-chaaaan! Give it all you've got~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hearing their voices shouting for me to do my best was all it took to steady my feet and push me forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, they're truly an incredible Cheer Squad. All of these folks here. They inspired me so much that I wanted to cheer someone on just like that someday.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, King, how about letting these veteran Cheer Squad senpai share some wisdom with you? You might just pick up something truly valuable, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...So that is why you brought me here--

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And with that, I'm handing you over to the wonderful folks of the shopping district! ...Don't give me that look. Getting all sentimental and preaching about dreams isn't really my style, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm, the secret to cheering? Let's see... for me, it's gotta be heartfelt sincerity, I suppose. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Meat Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Let's see here~... Alright, if Na-chan needs our help, we're holding a strategy meeting! Everyone, gather 'round~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? A-a full meeting is a bit over the top... Just a quick tip or two would be plenty!

text_block_list.name: Tea Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: My, my, a brainstorming session with everyone? In that case, allow me to brew a fresh pot of coffee...

text_block_list.name: Tofu Vendor Old Man
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Fresh coffee from the tea shop lady sounds fantastic! Alright, let's put our heads together~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District People
text_block_list.text: Oooooh--!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...So this is... Nature-san's Cheer Squad.

text_block_list.name: Snack Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, even at this late hour, they're as lively as ever, aren't they? Whenever it's about Na-chan, everyone gets so passionate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Indeed, seeing them united like this, they truly are a magnificent cheer squad.

text_block_list.name: Snack Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh! ...Hearing you say that warms my heart. After all, it's probably the proudest specialty this shopping street has to offer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Is there someone who acts as the Captain? When cheering on Nature-san, is there any special technique you employ?

text_block_list.name: Snack Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, nothing so formal, I'm afraid... We don't have anyone we'd call a Captain, nor do we prepare anything elaborate.

text_block_list.name: Snack Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: ...Just raising our voices together and holding each other's hands. All we had was the shared wish to cheer on Na-chan; I'm not even sure if our voices were ever properly in sync.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
............
Just raising your voices... and holding each other's hands...?

text_block_list.name: Snack Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, my apologies if that sounded overly simplistic. I'm sure an esteemed Captain like yourself already knows such basic things, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...No. It seems those very fundamentals were what eluded me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm, King? Did you manage to get some good advice?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes. Immeasurably so. That is why--

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Let us give it our utmost effort, together.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph... It may be modest and unrefined, but I intend to build our squad from the true fundamentals!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We are members of the same "Squad," after all. We cheer as one, and together convey our heartfelt gratitude. True solidarity is--

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: --not about blindly following someone. Perhaps it begins simply with the shared desire to create something together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...! Heh... Fufufu. So that's how it is. ...Consider your gratitude warmly received.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, King, you really are so awkward... and way too earnest. It feels straight out of a classic drama--like a coworker passing you a canned coffee on the office rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still... yeah, let's do this! Let's give our absolute best to cheer on everyone competing in the Fan Appreciation Festival!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Pffft, good grief. Now I'm the one spouting cheesy lines. Guess I haven't grown out of that at all~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To me, nothing could bring greater joy than hearing those very words. ...So, will you do me the honor of accepting this?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gladly. Hehe, though warm sweet red-bean soup, huh... quite the regal choice, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...And what is wrong with that, pray tell?! Out of everything in the vending machine, it seemed the most suited to warm your core!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...To everyone here, thank you very much for your assistance tonight. Thanks to all of you, I believe I have grasped the essential key.

text_block_list.name: Tofu Vendor Old Man
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's wonderful to hear! Give it everything you've got out there, Captain-san! By the way, if you ever hit a wall again...

text_block_list.name: Tofu Vendor Old Man
text_block_list.text: You should go ask last year's Captain, Bamboo-chan! Her cheers had enough fiery passion to move mountains, after all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...! You are quite right; seeking counsel from last year's captain is a marvelous idea! Very well, we shall go speak with Bamboo-san--

text_block_list.name: King & Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, Bamboo-san!?
